mapper.sql: SELECT policy_id::text, scope, tenant_id::text, policy_level, resource_kind, resource_id, publish_mode, enabled, updated_by, created_at, updated_at FROM cap_publish_policy
mapper.select: INSERT INTO cap_publish_policy (policy_id, scope, tenant_id, policy_level, resource_kind, resource_id, publish_mode, enabled, updated_by) VALUES (#{policyId}, #{scope}, #{tenantId}::uuid, #{policyLevel}, #{resourceKind}, #{resourceId}, #{publishMode}, #{enabled}, #{updatedBy}) RETURNING created_at, updated_at

UPDATE cap_publish_policy SET publish_mode = #{publishMode}, enabled = #{enabled}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = now() WHERE policy_id = #{policyId}::uuid AND scope = #{scope} AND tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM #{tenantId}::uuid RETURNING created_at, updated_at
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cap_publish_policy WHERE policy_id = #{policyId}::uuid AND scope = #{scope} AND tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM #{tenantId}::uuid
mapper.select: WHERE scope = #{scope} AND (tenant_id IS NULL OR tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM #{tenantId}::uuid) AND enabled = true ORDER BY policy_level, resource_kind NULLS FIRST
